messages:
Arjun: Hey all — opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/5478 for a small change to KV-cache eviction that should reduce tail latency. Need runtime + infra + security eyes before I merge. TL;DR: tighter eviction threshold + minor refactor, no model code changes.

Arjun: PR description/snippet:
```
- Reduce kv_cache_retention from 3 to 2 (config)
- Add safe-evict check to avoid OOM during spikes
- Unit + integration tests added
```

Maya: Quick question — does this change affect cross-tenant memory accounting or any global allocator?

Arjun: No cross-tenant changes. Measured locally on a3.large: before p95=118ms, after p95=112ms; peak GPU mem down ~4%. No allocator API changes.

Sam: Can you add a short canary rollout plan? infra needs the config flag gate and an easy revert. Also leaving a note: if this touches autoscaler hooks we need to validate.

Arjun: Canary plan in PR comments, excerpt:
```
Canary: 5% traffic -> 25% -> 100% over 4 hours, auto-rollback on error-rate>0.5% or p95 regression>+10ms
Config flag: kv_evict_v2=true (defaults false)
Rollback: flip flag back, redeploy service group
```

Sam: ok leaving a review, will run the rollout in staging after CI passes.

Taylor: Security quick check — any new env vars, secret accesses, or widened permissions? Also drop an SCA report link if you ran it.

Arjun: No new secrets. Only a config flag (non-sensitive). Ran `snyk test` locally — no new findings. attaching output in PR.

ci-bot: CI: build failed on job "python-tests" — flaky test_kv_cache.py::test_eviction_logic (timeout). Full logs: https://ci.redwood/67890/build/1223

Arjun: Thanks CI — will investigate the flaky test, pushing a fix in a minute.

Arjun: Pushed fix (commit 9f4b2c3) — re-run CI.

ci-bot: CI: all checks passed for commit 9f4b2c3.

Lila: Heads-up from SRE — please avoid immediate global rollout, start with single region canary for this one. If infra wants larger canary later we can coordinate.

Sam: Reviewed the runtime/infrastructure interaction, no blockers from infra. Left a couple of nits in the code comments. Approving now. :thumbsup:

Taylor: Checked the SCA and config surface. Security approved — no secrets and no perf regression causing side-channel concerns. Approving from sec.

Maya: Platform LGTM — tests good, perf numbers reasonable. One tiny doc nit.

Arjun: Thanks! merging now and kicking off canary in us-west-2. Will post status. :shipit:

infra-bot: Deployment started: service=runtime, canary=5%, region=us-west-2, author=Arjun, run=deploy-2026-03-17-09

Arjun: Canary healthy after 30m (errors=0, p95 stable). Increasing to 25%.

Arjun: Canary to 25% stable after 2h. Proceeding to 100% next window.

Arjun: Rollout complete — no regressions observed. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
